envelope.description: Add the shared revise-or-author check to the author gate

body.title: Add the shared revise-or-author check to the author gate
body.summary: Add assertMayReviseDraft(repoPath, unit, stage, authoring) to src/workflow/team/author-gate.ts: it asks teamGate for 'revise' when isUnderSignoff(repoPath, unit, stage) holds and for 'author' otherwise, keeps the first-author exception for a stage with no issue, applies assertHeld for 'revise', throws TeamGateRefusedError for any other outcome and rethrows a ToolDenied. assertMayAuthor calls it for the unit and stage it already finds, so its behaviour and its three call sites do not change.
acceptanceChecks: the helper asks for 'revise' when the stage is in signoff or changes-requested and for 'author' otherwise, and applies assertHeld for 'revise'
a repo with no team policy resolves with no tracker call
a ToolDenied is rethrown and every other refusal is a TeamGateRefusedError
the existing assertMayAuthor tests pass unchanged
